thread:
Ava: Final call: product launch blog draft is here https://docs.google.com/example. Target publish 2026-04-15 11:00 PT. Need quick checks: headline, benchmark line, hero image choice, UTMs, and webinar CTA + routing. Please flag by 3pm.

Tom: On it. I'll review headline and CTA.

Priya: Legal notes: say "based on internal testing" and add the methodology link. Avoid absolutes and competitor names. No logos without approvals.

Rahul: Benchmarks: redwood-4x, 2k context. Latest run shows p95=117.9ms and cost ~27% lower vs baseline. Recommend wording: "based on internal testing; p95 ≈118ms and up to 27% lower inference cost."

Dana: Design: two hero options in Figma (chart vs UI). I recommend chart for social creatives. Link: https://figma.com/file/example-hero. Screenshots blurred.

Chris: UTMs: utm_source=blog utm_medium=organic utm_campaign=launch-apr2026 utm_content=chart|ui. Webinar reg: inline form; route leads to HubSpot list "inbound-launch-apr". SDR handles initial outreach unless score>30 then AE.

Ava: Thanks. @Priya add the methodology link and the legal footnote. @Tom pick headline and CTA by 3pm. If no objections I'll lock at 4pm and schedule publish.

Tom: Headline option I like: "Predictable latency, lower inference cost". CTA: "Save your spot".

Priya: Legal approved with footnote: "Results vary by workload and configuration; see methodology."

Rahul: Confirmed numbers posted to the internal bench doc: https://internal.example.com/benchmarks/redwood-4x-2026.

Ava: Locking copy/design handoff at 4pm. Thanks team! :rocket:
